quote: In this paper, we explore the detectability of AItext in professional and informal writing scenarios and validate the vulnerabilities in current detection systems through perturbation experiments.
outputs: The paper evaluates detection models on AI-generated text from LLMs and analyzes perturbed versions of such text.

quote: To assess the changes in semantic similarity and readability introduced by perturbed text, we report four text quality metrics. 1) The semantic similarity between the original and perturbed text, calculated using the P-SP model. 2) The Flesch Reading Ease score, quantifying text readability, with 0 indicating a highly specialized text and 100 representing a fifth-grade level. 3) Text quality scores judged by GPT-3.5-Turbo, ranging from 0 to 10, with 10 being the highest score. 4) Perplexity, assessed using the 7B LLaMA-2-base model to evaluate text fluency.
